name: login-edge-cases
description: Tests negative login scenarios: empty fields, wrong credentials, and validation messages

doc_metadata.title: Clear Session
doc_metadata.caption: Clear browser cookies and local storage to ensure a clean test state.

doc_metadata.title: Empty Credentials Error
doc_metadata.caption: If you attempt to sign in without entering credentials, the system displays a validation message prompting you to fill in the required fields.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the validation error that appears when submitting the login form with empty fields.

doc_metadata.title: Invalid Credentials Error
doc_metadata.caption: If you enter an incorrect username or password, the system displays an error message. Verify your credentials and try again. After multiple failed attempts, your account may be temporarily locked.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Capture the error message displayed after failed login. This goes in the Troubleshooting section.
